LightningComponentBundle.description: A simple custom carousel with different configuration options.

property.name: slidesData
property.label: Slides Data (JSON)
property.description: JSON array of slides with image, heading, and description properties. Example: [{'image':'url','heading':'Title','description':'Text'}]

property.name: scrollDuration
property.label: Scroll Duration (ms)
property.description: Duration in milliseconds after which the next slide is displayed

property.name: aspectRatio
property.label: Aspect Ratio
property.description: Fixed aspect ratio of the slides, e.g. '16:9' or '4/3'. The images then fill the slides and are cropped where needed. Takes precedence over Custom Height.

property.name: transition
property.label: Transition
property.description: How the carousel moves to another slide: 'fade' blends the new slide in, 'slide' moves it in from the side. Both are switched off when the user prefers reduced motion.

property.name: hideNavigationDots
property.label: Hide Navigation Dots
property.description: Hide the navigation dots below the carousel

property.name: hideSlideNumber
property.label: Hide Slide Number
property.description: Hide the current slide number indicator

property.name: hideSlideText
property.label: Hide Slide Text
property.description: Hide the text overlay with heading and description

property.name: showCard
property.label: Show Lightning Card
property.description: If present, the carousel is wrapped in a lightning card to fit better into the overall page layout.

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card Icon
property.description: If show card option is active, the card icon is displayed in the header before the card title. It should contain the SLDS name of the icon. Specify the name in the format 'utility:down' where 'utility' is the category and 'down' the icon to be displayed.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: If show card option is active, the card title can include text and is displayed in the header above the carousel.
